# Opal Pettigrew

## Overview

- **Age:** Slightly older than Nell (in class with her, turning into a young woman during volume 2)  <sub>[v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 c29 P1](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c11 P11](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0011)</sub>
- **Status:** Student / Teacher-in-training  <sub>[v1 c11 P11](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0011), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c9 P25](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0025), [v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018)</sub>
- **Role:** Student; later schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c11 P11](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0011), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020)</sub>

## Appearance

Opal is a very attractive young woman, considered by some to be the most beautiful girl at Regent's. She has a radiant complexion, big vivid blue eyes, a full and eye-catching figure, and long, dark hair.

_Sources: [v2 c29 P1](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0001)_

## Personality

Opal is sunny, pleasant, and highly emotional, often prone to tears, panic, or hysterics over minor events or school scares. She is deeply interested in romance, boys, and flirtation, possessing a theatrical and sentimental streak that manifests in her storytelling. Though easily flustered and occasionally vain, she is warm-hearted and a friendly member of the Brierley youth group.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c15 P66](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0066), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v2 c26 P5](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0005)_

- Emotional and prone to hysterics  <sub>[v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c15 P66](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0066), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c32 P21](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0021)</sub>

- Sentimental  <sub>[v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021)</sub>

## Abilities

- Storytelling (though overly romantic)  <sub>[v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021)</sub>

## Goals

- To teach for a few years and then marry  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>
- To have numerous suitors and enjoy a gay youth  <sub>[v1 c18 P10](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0010), [v2 c26 P20](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0020)</sub>

## History

Opal attended Brierley school, where she shared classes with Nell Harcourt, Isolde Pembroke, and others. She was known among her peers for reporting gossip about the teacher and for her dramatic emotional reactions to classroom mishaps, such as when Hugh Carrow tied her hair to her chair or when firecrackers exploded in the stove. She participated in the Sunday-school picnic, joined the story-writing club, and took part in the school's Christmas concert in the tableau 'Grace, Hope and Charity.' Later, she entered Regent's Academy to prepare for the Entrance examination to become a teacher. After passing her exams, she secured a teaching position in a town further west.

_Sources: [v1 c11 P18](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0018), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v1 c36 P8](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0008)_
